hook: Apple’s hidden Mikey chip protocol finally decoded
hooks: Apple’s hidden Mikey chip protocol finally decoded
Assumption that iPod button protocol was undocumented is broken
Enables adding headset button support to Rockbox in minutes
what_happened: Hemant reverse‑engineered Mikey’s I2C resistive button protocol and implemented it in Rockbox
why_it_matters: Opens modern firmware to use original iPod headset buttons, removing lack of support bottleneck
the_catch: Works only on classic iPods that are very cold; long‑press handling limited by Rockbox driver
caption: The Mikey chip in classic iPods uses a simple I2C resistive‑encoding protocol for headset buttons, now reverse‑engineered and added to Rockbox. How will this revive your old iPod’s remote functions?
alt_text: The carousel explains that the Mikey chip’s button protocol was decoded, added to Rockbox, its impact, and its limitation.

es.hook: El protocolo oculto del chip Mikey de Apple finalmente fue descifrado
es.what_happened: Hemant realizó ingeniería inversa del protocolo de botones resistivo I2C de Mikey y lo implementó en Rockbox
es.why_it_matters: Permite que el firmware moderno use los botones originales del auricular del iPod, eliminando el cuello de botella por falta de soporte
es.the_catch: Solo funciona en iPods clásicos que están muy fríos; el manejo de pulsaciones largas está limitado por el controlador de Rockbox
